status: passed independent reboot persistence of distinct same-offset raw patterns
prerequisite: intel-current-same-lba.json records partition exclusion checks and concurrent flushed writes of different 128 KiB patterns at LBA6290000 on each disk
proof: Each guest rebooted independently through systemctl reboot. Original pinned SSH identity authenticated a new boot ID, the exact original raw pattern and the original filesystem witness. During each reboot the other guest authenticated and returned its unchanged boot ID and raw pattern.
limits: Discrete peer checks, not uninterrupted throughput. Guest reboot persistence is not outer-host power-loss durability or comprehensive capability/bounds qualification. No release claim.
